title: 3 Spider-Man Variants People Mix Up
script: This is Spider-Man 2099. This is Miles Morales. So what's the difference? Spider-Man 2099 uses genetic fangs and talons, while Miles Morales uses venom electricity and camouflage. This is Spider-Gwen. This is Spider-Woman. So what's the difference? Spider-Gwen is Gwen Stacy with drum-beat instincts, while Spider-Woman is Jessica Drew with bio-electric venom. This is Cosmic Spider-Man. This is Captain Universe. So what's the difference? Cosmic Spider-Man is Peter Parker bonded with Enigma Force, while Captain Universe is Uni-Power sent for cosmic balance. Follow for more.
